name: fly-fast
description: Flying travel at 4000 units/s, 400 units above the ground: the travel route (Riverwood road to the hills south-east of Whiterun), one long straight leg west across the tundra, then the check route north past Rorikstead. About 130,000 units. For stutter and pop-in while moving fast, the way a player flies the demo (F, Ctrl for fast). The speed matches the player's fly speeds (crate::player FLY_SPEED and FLY_FAST_SPEED).
notes: Waypoints are travel.json then check.json unchanged; the leg between them is new. 400 units of eye height keeps the camera above every water level on the way (travel's notes put water at most a few hundred units above the terrain).
